transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got the resupply aircraft departing at 0900 tomorrow, and we need to finalize the load plan at our 0730 cargo huddle. We have four cargo lots — the battery pallet, the refrigerated clinic shipment, the generator-filter crate, and the communications-cable pallet — and four positions: P1 forward-left, P2 forward-right, P3 aft-left, and P4 aft-right. Before I sign off on the plan, I need each of you to bring your placement constraints to the table — tie-down requirements, power needs, clearance issues, and any segregation concerns. Let's hear what everyone's got so we can sort out the right configuration.
